criteria.id: a caller reads a static workflow map with stages, steps, and layer toggles without running it
the same template is shown as stage swimlane, role swimlane, dependency graph, and outline
validation badges appear on incomplete or invalid nodes
two template versions can be compared for added, removed, and changed steps
a test run replays over the same workflow map with frame-by-frame states
the replay report exports as publication evidence
customers cannot export a replay report
